requirement.edition: Resolution MSC.385(94), adopted 21 Nov 2014; consolidated with MEPC.264(68), adopted 15 May 2015
requirement.normalizedRequirement: IF ship_exposed_to_ice_accretion = true, THEN every escape route, muster station, embarkation area, survival craft, launching appliance, and survival-craft access shall have an associated ice_or_snow_removal_or_prevention_means.
requirement.requiredInputs: Applicability assessment, protected-item inventory, and associated anti-icing means
requirement.source: International Code for Ships Operating in Polar Waters (Polar Code)
requirement.sourceText: For ships exposed to ice accretion, means shall be provided to remove or prevent ice and snow accretion from escape routes, muster stations, embarkation areas, survival craft, their launching appliances and access to survival craft.
